title: Lone Wolves and Lattices in Bayesian Matching with Transfers
abstract: arXiv:2611.34524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I study the Lone Wolf and lattice properties of stable outcomes in one-to-one matching with transferable utility and one-sided incomplete information, using the Bayesian stable market states of Liu (2020) and Chen and Hu (2024). With transfers, the wage in a blocking offer screens the worker's types, so it determines both whom the firm attracts and what the firm learns. I show by example that the firm-side and matched-set versions of the Lone Wolf property, as well as the lattice property, can fail even when outcomes are compared under the same information structure. I then assume that each worker's matching value is additively separable in his type and the firm's identity. Under this condition, a firm that is unmatched in some stable outcome earns zero in every stable outcome with the same type profile and information structure. translated_title: 带转移支付的贝叶斯匹配中的“独狼”与格性质
translated_abstract: 本文研究了一对一匹配中在可转移效用与单边不完全信息条件下稳定结果的“独狼”性质与格性质，采用Liu (2020)以及Chen和Hu (2024)提出的贝叶斯稳定市场状态概念。在存在转移支付时，阻断出价中的工资水平能够对工人的类型进行筛选，因此它同时决定了企业能够吸引到谁以及企业能够获知什么。作者通过例子表明，即使各结果是在相同的信息结构下进行比较，企业侧与匹配集合版本的独狼性质以及格性质都可能失效。随后，作者假设每个工人的匹配价值在其自身类型与企业身份之间是可加可分的。在该条件下，在某一稳定结果中未获匹配的企业，在具有相同类型概况与信息结构的每一个稳定结果中所得收益均为零。由于工人可以保留信息租金，工人侧的独狼性质可能失效。不过，除有限的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文研究带转移支付与单边不完全信息的贝叶斯匹配中稳定结果的独狼性质与格性质，证明在工人的匹配价值对其类型和企业身份可加可分这一条件下，企业侧的独狼性质得以成立，而工人侧性质和格性质一般会失效。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the Lone Wolf and lattice properties of stable outcomes in Bayesian matching with transfers and one-sided incomplete information, showing that under additive separability of workers' matching values in their types and firm identities, the firm-side Lone Wolf property holds while the worker-side property and lattice structure may fail.
